cloud management.value: Aruba Central — cloud-hosted management platform supporting zero-touch provisioning, topology views, and REST API; hybrid on-premises gateway options also available

result.summary: All three vendors — Cisco Meraki, Juniper Mist, and Aruba Central — offer cloud-native Wi-Fi management with subscription-based licensing in a broadly similar per-AP annual cost range (roughly $120–$160 for Wi-Fi 6E tiers, though actual pricing varies significantly by volume, tier, and negotiated contract). Juniper Mist is widely recognized for the depth of its AI assurance capabilities via Marvis Virtual Network Assistant, making it a strong choice for campuses prioritizing proactive, AI-driven troubleshooting. Cisco Meraki offers the most established and widely deployed cloud management dashboard with a large ecosystem and strong support network, but its AI features are less prominent. Aruba Central provides a competitive AIOps offering and flexible deployment options (including hybrid on-premises gateways), which may appeal to institutions with mixed infrastructure requirements. All pricing and feature details above are estimates based on secondary sources and general product knowledge; Northwind University should obtain formal quotes and verify current tier structures directly with each vendor before making a final decision.
